item.title: Microsoft: October Windows update may break Smart App Control
item.description: Microsoft says some users may have trouble turning on Smart App Control after installing this month's KB5127648 Windows 11 security update.

item.title: Microsoft fixes bug causing Windows black screens, Explorer crashes
item.description: Microsoft has resolved a known issue that was causing black screens, desktop loading issues, and Explorer crashes after installing Windows 11 updates released since August.

item.title: Microsoft PowerToys adds CursorHide, Button Lock mouse tools
item.description: Microsoft has released PowerToys 0.102, with two new mouse utilities, new command-line tools, and Command Palette improvements.

item.title: Windows 11 KB5127648 & KB5126653 cumulative updates released
item.description: Microsoft has released the Patch Tuesday Windows 11 KB5127648 and KB5126653 cumulative updates to fix security vulnerabilities and bugs, and add new features.
